Blackwave Code: Togetherness- Make performance visible: Give leadership clear, up-to-date visibility into company performance through meaningful KPIs and management reviews that drive decisions rather than just report numbers. Blackwave Code: Candor- Own risk end-to-end: Establish and actively maintain a company-wide risk management system covering organizational, process, and product risks — with clear ownership and follow-up on mitigations. Blackwave Code: PlayfulnessYOUR PROFILE- 3–5+ years of experience in quality management within a manufacturing environment — you've stood on a shop floor, not just in an office- Degree in a technical field (e.g. aerospace or mechanical engineering) plus relevant further training in quality management- Hands-on ISO 9001 experience: you've managed audit cycles and can walk us through a process you set up yourself, end to end- Pragmatic quality mindset: you build processes for usage, not just for compliance — standards are an enabler, not bureaucracy- Builder mentality: you create structures from scratch rather than maintaining what's already there, and you see a bit of chaos as an opportunity- Strong ownership and communication at all levels — from C-level to operator- Fluent English is a must; German is a plusWHAT WE OFFER- Freedom to Create: Extensive decision-making freedom and short decision paths – we trust your expertise to lead your team.- Fresh Fuel Every Day: Shared lunch breaks with freshly prepared, varied meals to keep the team energized.- Coffee Culture @ Blackwave: Enjoy premium coffee from our portafilter machine or join one of our barista courses.- Choose Your Perk: Select from a Deutschland-Ticket, EGYM Wellpass, or a Give Card.- Gear up for Take-off: Receive premium Blackwave team apparel during your on boarding.- Grow in Aerospace: Expand your professional horizons in a high-growth company at the forefront of space technology.- Rooftop Relaxation: End your day on our spacious rooftop terrace with a panoramic view of the Alps.Please refer to reference number YF-51680 for your application.Apply for this job

jobs.description: A Snapshot of Your Day The Coating Engineer is part of a team of Mechanical and Materials Engineers within the Turbine Design Department. The purpose of this team is to support the development of new turbine components during design and process qualification and to disposition manufacturing non conformances of existing hardware. Also, an important aspect of this position will be to help implement and industrialize new coating technologies from technological development into the manufacturing environment in collaboration with internal and external technology development, manufacturing and sourcing organizations. This position is a central engineering interface between turbine design and turbine manufacturing and sourcing organizations. You are working with both departments and internal and external vendors to develop manufacturable designs during component development.How You’ll Make an Impact * Support of coating technology industrialization within the coating supply base* Execution and support of coating qualification activities for turbine hot gas path components* Evaluation of in‑process manufacturing data with regard to design intent* Assurance of compliance with design‑for‑manufacturing principles for new components* Preparation and revision of product definitions as well as design‑for‑manufacturing philosophies* Support of production issue resolution and implementation of quality and cost improvement measuresWhat You Bring* University degree in materials engineering, process engineering, mechanical engineering, or a comparable qualification* Longstanding years of professional experience in the field of high‑temperature coatings and/or materials engineering* In‑depth knowledge of thermal spray processes and coating properties* Prior knowledge of gas turbine hot gas path components, including materials and coating processes* Very good written and spoken German and English language skills as a prerequisiteAbout the TeamOur Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.  Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideoOur Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. Rewards/Benefits * In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs #RPO #ELECTRON # LGTEN
